name: Source Control & Merge Workbench
actions: inspect a separate clean Git working copy
build a deterministic public-safe sync plan
render a compact review summary and export the complete exact plan
configure a dedicated automation branch with manual push only
verify a reviewed plan digest without writing
run the fixed local sync runner as a bounded background job only with the exact reviewed digest and confirmation
commit only planned changed or new public-safe files
push the dedicated automation branch without merging
emit a draft pull-request candidate handoff
restore the clean pre-commit state when a remote push fails
summary: Let the local computer prepare, verify, and manually push one exact public-safe Workshop plan to a dedicated GitHub automation branch, with no deletion, credential storage, direct main push, pull-request creation, merge, or CANON authority.
notes: The fixed runner requires the exact digest of a freshly reviewed plan plus a typed manual confirmation. The Hub shows a bounded summary and exports the complete exact plan on request. Push work runs in Machine Host so the interface stays responsive; a failed remote push restores the clean pre-commit state when possible. Heartbeat's future seam is read-only verification; unattended push is reserved and unavailable.
